The church can be found in the [[graveyard]], but access to it is blocked off until you become a [[Perks|preacher]]. The church starts with a base 3 {{Church Rating}} rating and in the beginning, the [[Sermon|casual prayer]] you are given for free will be the only one you can perform reliably. Holding sermons in the church once each {{Day|Pride}} is the main method of collecting  {{item|Faith}}, a necessary resource for [[Study table|study]], [[Crafting Stations|crafting]], and [[Zombie|zombies]], as well as a source of [[money]]. 

You can eventually craft [[Sermon|sermons]] that offer [[Effects|buffs and perks]] beyond the small amount of faith and money the starter sermon offers.

== Church upgrade ==
The church can be opened and upgraded twice by talking to the [[Bishop]] at {{Day|Pride}} and following his [[Quests|questline]]. For each step, you'll need to meet a minimum {{Graveyard Rating}} and {{Church Rating}} in addition to turning in items. For more details see [[Bishop]].

'''Note:''' Be careful not to complete the interaction with the [[Bishop]] to upgrade your church before you can afford the appropriate [[The Graveyard#Royal Services|papers]]. Otherwise you won't be able to perform sermons. With a decent big church of 50 {{Church Rating}} and a good graveyard with about 200 {{Graveyard Rating}}, you can earn {{Money|3000}} to {{Money|4000}} each {{Day|Pride}} by using a {{quality|gold}} quality sermon.

== Sermon ==
<blockquote>For the main article see [[sermon]].</blockquote>Every week on {{Day|Pride}} you'll be able to perform a sermon in the church.  The number of parishioners attending this sermon and the amount of {{Item|Faith}} they provide you with is largely dependent on your church rating {{Church Rating}}, the type of sermon you perform and the quality of it. Each 5 {{Church Rating}} provides 1 [[Faith]], each {{Church Rating}} after that provides a 20% chance to gain one additional faith.

The amount of [[money]] you collect in the [[donation box]] is determined by the graveyard rating {{Graveyard Rating}} with a bonus from {{Church Rating}}, and also by the type and quality of the sermon performed.

You need the {{item|rightful citizen papers}} to perform a sermon at the big church. 
While you do '''not''' need {{item|aristocrat papers}} to perform a sermon in the cathedral, they are required to further the [[Bishop]] questline.
